title: Predictive-Quotient Bisimulation
common_comparison_type: A predictive comparison object Q_* with typed legs e_S:Q_S->Q_* and e_T:Q_T->Q_* or a relation R subset Q_S x Q_T.
copy_rule: Every qualifying copy is a structural branch; no unique target is selected by quotient equivalence.
fusion_rule: Return fusion-valued ancestry only when a target predictive class lawfully combines all declared predecessors.
route_policy: Routes may differ; route independence is claimed only after a flatness/confluence or zero-holonomy proof on the predictive object.
autonomy_gate: Remove source execution, bridge translators, and any external predictive oracle; then recompute target transitions from X_T alone.
approximate_version: An epsilon-bisimulation metric on predictive transition systems with a declared horizon and composition law.
hidden_state_requirement: Public equivalence is insufficient; privileged continuation tests or complete-state quotient construction are required in toys.
composition_rule: Compose typed bisimulations only when continuation and clock translators align; retain accumulated route defect.

title: Full C-Package Staged Handoff
common_comparison_type: A typed package specification CPkg_* plus source/target realization maps and a global coherence object.
copy_rule: Multiple certified targets remain multiple structural successors; certification never selects one token.
fusion_rule: Fusion-valued only after conflict resolution and one globally coherent fused package are proved.
route_policy: Intermediate stages may be partial, but completion requires a globally coherent endpoint; route independence needs confluence on all retained package data.
autonomy_gate: Remove source, bridge, decoder, migration controller, and external audit service; retain only the declared target environment/resources.
approximate_version: A vector defect for each clause plus hard gate failures, with a stability theorem required before any approximate pass.
hidden_state_requirement: C4/non-exposure is re-audited relative to target interfaces; a larger interface may alter the predicate.
composition_rule: Compose only when target package outputs of one stage satisfy the source contract of the next and global glue is preserved.

title: Causal-Overlap Process Continuation
common_comparison_type: A changing-support process history H over a joint time/order base with source and target support projections.
copy_rule: A detached copy is a new target process; if a continuous process genuinely forks, the lineage relation branches from the fork.
fusion_rule: Requires an actual coupled process merger; endpoint state fusion alone is insufficient.
route_policy: Replacement order can matter; process continuity is route-specific unless all critical pairs commute on the selected organization.
autonomy_gate: Withdraw all source-side process contributions and the migration controller after the takeover boundary.
approximate_version: A process-simulation tube with lower bounds on coupling/organizational continuity and explicit gap tolerance only if separately defined.
hidden_state_requirement: Operational causal organization may be privileged and is not inferred from public smoothness.
composition_rule: Concatenate overlap histories only when the terminal mixed process of one leg is the initial process of the next.

title: Viability–Repair Control Transport
common_comparison_type: A controlled-behavior specification with resource and credit translators.
copy_rule: Several viable copies can be structural successors; viability does not choose one.
fusion_rule: Fusion-valued only when control conflicts and credit ledgers admit one coherent merged policy.
route_policy: Routes spend resources and can alter repair state; route independence requires equal transported budgets/credits or a bounded defect law.
autonomy_gate: Remove source controller, bridge, decoder, external repair, and transferred temporary resources; retain ordinary target environment.
approximate_version: Robust controlled simulation with viability margin m and defect epsilon<m under a named disturbance class.
hidden_state_requirement: Viability and repair state can be hidden from public behavior until a disturbance or long-horizon withdrawal test.
composition_rule: Compose controlled simulations only if the intermediate viability margin exceeds accumulated defect and currency translators compose.

title: Encoded Logical-Package Migration
common_comparison_type: A logical package space L_* with source and target encoders/decoders.
copy_rule: Classical logical packages may be duplicated, yielding branch-valued structural successors; no-cloning-like restrictions must be stated if relevant.
fusion_rule: Fusion-valued only through a declared merge code that resolves incompatible logical records.
route_policy: Different code-switch routes may have logical holonomy; route independence requires commuting intertwiners modulo gauge.
autonomy_gate: Remove original support, migration decoder, and external recovery controller; test the target code using target resources.
approximate_version: Logical defect bounded below threshold for a declared horizon, with code-change and recovery composition laws.
hidden_state_requirement: Syndromes reveal code-relative defects but not all package-relevant hidden structure.
composition_rule: Compose channels with a proved logical-error budget and compatible code interfaces.

title: Closure–Gluing Fixed-Point Span
common_comparison_type: A closure algebra L_* or completion C with embeddings of source and target local package data.
copy_rule: Independent and source-derived fixed-point twins can both pass S-T; only route/history data can add lineage.
fusion_rule: One fused target exists only if predecessor data glue without contradiction.
route_policy: Route independence is diagram commutativity/flatness on the closure object, not endpoint equality.
autonomy_gate: Remove source-side local records and completion services not assigned to the target; recompute target closure/glue.
approximate_version: Bounded closure-commutator and gluing residual with a separate fixed-point stability theorem.
hidden_state_requirement: Closure/fixed-point access is privileged; public behavior need not determine it.
composition_rule: Compose spans/cospans only when pullback/pushout and descent data exist; otherwise return a global obstruction.

title: Recombination–Holonomy Continuation Functor
common_comparison_type: A typed category/groupoid of events, branches, joins, and route loops.
copy_rule: Source-derived copies are branches; independent structural twins lack an ancestry morphism.
fusion_rule: Fusion-valued only when a target join/recombination morphism receives all predecessor histories coherently.
route_policy: Route sensitivity is primary; route independence is a theorem only on a flat subcategory.
autonomy_gate: Remove bridge event generator and source-supported morphisms; test whether the target category/dynamics persists.
approximate_version: Defect-enriched functor with composition, recombination, and holonomy residuals.
hidden_state_requirement: Recombination and loop probes may be unavailable at public interfaces.
composition_rule: Ordinary functor composition when intermediate categories and selected structure align; branch relations compose explicitly.

title: Reflexive Temporal–Credit Ledger Bridge
common_comparison_type: A history/ledger comparison object with clock connection and provenance morphisms.
copy_rule: Copies share a prefix and become distinct ledger branches; no branch is uniquely selected by later deletion.
fusion_rule: Fusion is underdetermined or blocked unless conflicting self/credit histories admit an explicit reconciliation law.
route_policy: Order strongly matters; route independence is not expected when replacement order changes credit or phase history.
autonomy_gate: Remove source clock, scheduler, ledger service, bridge synchronizer, and source minting authority.
approximate_version: Vector defect for phase/order, self-update, credit provenance, and ledger reconciliation, with hard nonretroactivity gates.
hidden_state_requirement: Ledger and self-update structure may be privileged and can differ behind identical reports.
composition_rule: Compose only when clock maps are monotone and ledger authorities/provenance align; retain branch prefixes.

title: Residual-Bounded Predictive Simulation Bundle
common_comparison_type: A probe-indexed bundle specification with vector metric and hard gates.
copy_rule: Every qualifying source-derived copy can be a branch; small defect never selects a unique person.
fusion_rule: Fusion-valued or underdetermined depending on whether histories/gates admit one bounded merged bundle.
route_policy: Route defects accumulate by a declared nonlinear law; route-independent labels require all relevant loop defects below margin.
autonomy_gate: Remove source, bridge, decoder, external scheduler, and repair service; recompute residual under target dynamics.
approximate_version: Defining form: Delta<=epsilon componentwise, epsilon below named stability/viability margins.
hidden_state_requirement: Probe completeness is a declared limitation; public-only probes cannot close the hidden residual.
composition_rule: Compose simulations with an explicit bound F(Delta_1,Delta_2); reject if any hard gate or margin is crossed.

title: Heterogeneous Predictive-Ancestry Relation
common_comparison_type: A typed route record and a relation L_ST subset PredHist(X_S) x PredHist(X_T).
copy_rule: Nondestructive qualifying copies are branches; source persistence is compatible with plural succession.
fusion_rule: Fusion-valued with multiple predecessors when one target predictive history lawfully receives them.
route_policy: Lineage is route-scoped; route-independent ancestry is a stronger flatness theorem.
autonomy_gate: Autonomy is tested independently; lineage relation can hold even when a target later fails maintenance.
approximate_version: Open: either a graded ancestry witness or a robust classification away from relation bifurcations; not assumed.
hidden_state_requirement: Predictive ancestry may require privileged history access; public reports are insufficient.
composition_rule: Relational composition with retained intermediate route witnesses; special rules are required for fission followed by fusion.
